scope: One test transition in packages/url4/tests/spec/test_processor_delegation.py: test_unknown_id_raises_and_names_the_declared_routes becomes test_unknown_id_raises_without_naming_the_declared_routes, and its assertion that the message contains '/claude' becomes an assertion that the message contains neither '/claude' nor '/gpt4'. The 'nope' assertion and the rest of the test are unchanged. The same file gains one new test, test_an_unknown_id_keeps_its_code_and_stays_permanent; it is an addition, listed here only because this approval pins the whole file. No other edits.
reason: The review of PR #1606 showed that a nested peer call choosing processor=<unknown id> made _route_for_id list every route the Engine declares, private configured-endpoint routes included, and the run's terminal frame carried that list to the caller's own WebSocket. The owner chose to fix this in url4 on 2026-10-29: the refusal names only the id the caller passed and keeps ErrorCode.UNKNOWN_PROCESSOR and permanent=True. The old test pinned the listing, so it must assert the opposite.
